content: They started with the run‑book step that checks the Kafka data‑disk (the partition storage under `/data/kafka`). Using **RB‑009 step 1** they ran `df -h /data/kafka` on all three Kafka brokers. The output showed the same usage on each broker and, importantly, **kafka‑03 was not an outlier**—its partition storage was already cleared and matched the other nodes. Because the partition disk showed normal, identical usage across the cluster, they could rule it out as the source of the `/var` disk‑usage alarm before moving on to investigate the root filesystem.
name: gather
